ADLBC.R2A1LO.CR-8.2.reason: Define-XML ADLBC.R2A1LO divides by A1HI, the opposite normal limit from the lower-limit ratio named by its label and SAP page 12. These are different denominators, not alternative wording of the same ratio.

ADLBC.R2A1LO.CR-5.reason: Lines 239-253 of adlbc-documented-rules.yaml run the Define-XML ADLBC.R2A1LO rule AVAL/A1HI at 1 digit and differ as reported, and the SAP page-12 limit reading still differs. adlbc.r L187-L189 computes R2A1LO = AVAL / A1LO and nothing later in the program rounds or overwrites it, so the R2A1LO__UNROUNDED reading is supported as how the reference was computed, not as documentation.

ADLBC.ALBTRVAL.CR-5.reason: Lines 327-349 of adlbc-documented-rules.yaml keep both signed subtractions of Define-XML ADLBC.ALBTRVAL with 3-digit rounding, so the reported differences follow the literal rule. adlbc.r L193-L195 takes abs() of both terms and later steps (L199-L241) neither round nor overwrite ALBTRVAL, so ALBTRVAL__ABSOLUTE is supported as the reference computation, labelled as departing from the Define formula.
